What Exactly Is a Calorie?

A calorie, or more correctly, a kilocalorie, is a measure of energy. It

is the amount of heat needed to raise 1 liter of water by 1 degree

Celsius. (If you need to convert kilocalories to kilojoules, you can

do so by multiplying the number of calories by 4.1868.) Exercise

that raises your body temperature exemplifies how burning calories
converts into heat.
